skills.name: Demonic Grip
skills.description:
Argus stretches out a demonic hand in the target direction, dealing 125<font color='#D58E1F'>( +60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to the first enemy hero or Creep hit, stunning them for 0.7s, and pulling him and the target towards each other. If no enemy is hit, Argus pulls himself toward the hand's destination instead.
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: Argus dashes and strikes in the target direction, dealing 175<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies along the path.
skills.tips: -This skill is needs to be usedwell since it greatly helps Argus’ mobility in the battlefield. -Can be used to catch enemyheroes since it inflicts stun and propels Argus towards the enemy hero. -The second activation of thisskill can help you position yourself on your enemy and deal additional damage. -The grapple goes throughterrains, which gives you better a chance of a successful pursuit or retreat.But, if your final travel point is a terrain, you won’t get through the terrainand just bump into it.

skills.name: Meteoric Sword
skills.description:
After a short delay, Argus thrusts his Meteoric Sword in the target direction, dealing 300<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies hit (200% damage against minions) and reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 0.8s. The delay time will decrease as Argus' Attack Speed increases.
Enemy heroes or Creeps hit will be <font color='#404495'>(Cursed)</font> for 4s, during which they will leave a Cursed Trail behind. Argus gains 40% Movement Speed while on a Cursed Trail. Argus' Basic Attacks on <font color='#404495'>(Cursed)</font> targets will grant double <font color='#404495'>(Malice Energy)</font>.
<font color='#404495'>(Meteoric Sword)</font> damage counts as Basic Attack damage and can trigger Attack Effects.
skills.tips: -This skill greatly helps Argus’early game damage and can enhance the whole team’s mobility. -Can be used to quickly killminions and creeps. For best effect in lanes, hit the minions in a straightline. -The skill’s actual AOE and rangeis bigger than you think it is. -It also slows heroes down.

skills.name: Eternal Evil
skills.description:
Argus removes all debuffs on himself (except for Suppression) and enters <font color='#404495'>(Eternal Evil)</font> state, gaining <font color='#404495'>(Death Immunity)</font> for 4s. While in this state, 100% of his damage dealt to enemy heroes will be converted into HP for him once the state ends.
Leaving the <font color='#404495'>(Eternal Evil)</font> state also resets enemy Turrets' damage increase against Argus.]
<font color='#404495'>(Passive:)</font> Permanently increases the recharge of <font color='#404495'>(Malice Energy)</font> by 4 <font color='#404495'>(per second)</font>.
skills.tips: -This skill is what makes Argusspecial since it gives 5 seconds of death immunity, full rage bar (Instantdouble attack) and will convert 100% of damage done while the skill is active, intoHP after 5 secs. -Can be used even when stunned,transformed, silenced, airborne or while being pushed/pulled. But, it can’t beused while the other skills are in use. -Can turn the tide of a clashwhen used properly.

skills.name: Warmonger
skills.description:
When Argus' Meteoric Sword reaches 100 <font color='#404495'>(Malice Energy)</font>, he will launch a <font color='#404495'>(Demonic Slash)</font> with his next Basic Attack, dealing 200<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> and recovering 200<font color='#D58E1F'>( +10% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP. This attack ignores 40% of the target's Physical Defense.
Argus' Meteoric Sword gains 5 <font color='#404495'>(Malice Energy)</font> per second, and each of his Basic Attacks grants 10 <font color='#404495'>(Malice Energy)</font> (critical strikes grant an additional 5 energy).
skills.tips: -This skill is what helps Argusto be overpowered, especially when low in health. -Gives extra burst of damage. -The more HP that are missing,the faster the rage bar gets filled.

items.name: Demon Hunter Sword
items.des: Unique Passive - Devour: Basic Attacks deal 8% of the target's current HP as extra Physical Damage (capped at 60 against minions).

items.name: Corrosion Scythe
items.des: Unique Passive - Corrosion: Basic Attacks gain 80 extra Physical Damage and slow the target by 8% (halved for ranged Basic Attacks) for 1.5s. Stacks up to 5 times.

items.name: Berserker's Fury
items.des: Unique Passive - Doom: Critical strikes grant 5% extra Physical Attack for 2s.

items.name: Great Dragon Spear
items.des: Unique Passive - Supreme Warrior: After casting an Ultimate, increase Movement Speed by 15% for 7.5s. This effect has a 15s cooldown.

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

builds.tips: Mulai dengan Raptor Machete untuk membantu membersihkan Jungle, pada saat Midgame dapatkan 3 Item Attack Speed untuk membiarkan Warmonger dan Passive Demon Hunter Sword's Devour untuk meningkatkan Damage keseluruhan. Item keempat sekali lagi adalah Hunters Strike untuk kekuatan tambahan yang melekat, terakhir dapatkan Blade of Despair. Build ini membuat perkembangan cepat untuk Late Game Fighter.
